_comment: Sample response from POST /api/v1/auth/tokens/{tokenId}/rotate. The plaintext is shown exactly once in the response; only its SHA-256 fingerprint is persisted. The old token is retired (revoked_at set); the new token inherits the old token's name + scopes. An auth.token.rotate audit row is written tied to the old token's derived UUID5 entity_id. The old plaintext is no longer valid as a bearer.
name: ops
